verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party 'Offline support' help article (fastmail-docs-16/33). That article's snooze caveat ('if you're offline… you will not see the snoozed message reappear until you're back online') confirms the app operates offline and defers some server-side state until reconnect. The pack, however, captures only the article title and that one caveat. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that mail can be read offline, offline search, composing/sending while offline with queued delivery, documentation of how offline changes sync back on reconnect (e.g. conflict handling), and hands-on or community corroboration.
